title: Linear reindexing preserves bentness
statement: Let $n$ be even, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ be bent, and let $M:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n$ be an invertible linear map. Then the reindexed function $x\mapsto f(Mx)$ is bent.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is an invertible linear map from $\mathbb F_2^n$ to itself
